scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Geriatric Falls Prevention Grand Rounds able to use live badge-scanner attendance upload for tomorrow morning’s two-wave check-in.
Emerging Need: The scanner plan becomes fixed, but the temporary education-network credential required for live upload is missing before the provisioning batch closes.
Decision Context: Early room setup leaves scanner use conditional; later attendance volume, system preflight, and cutoff notices establish the absent prerequisite and narrow remaining window. The approved routing contact is only in shared activity records.
Consequence: If the credential path is not opened before intake closes, check-in can still occur offline but same-day attendance upload for the faculty evaluation review is lost.

parameter.title: Geriatric Falls Prevention Grand Rounds lobby check-in setup
parameter.description: Lobby check-in table and badge-scanner cart reserved; attendance method to be confirmed after registration count.

parameter.subject: Badge-scanner cart note for tomorrow's Grand Rounds
parameter.body: Projector, microphones, and the two-scanner cart are available for the Geriatric Falls Prevention Grand Rounds. If those scanners need live network upload, the temporary education-SSID request must be in the Learning Systems intake batch by 15:30 today. A/V can release the cart but does not issue scanner network credentials.

parameter.content: Registration just passed 118 and arrivals are split between residents coming off night shift and clinic staff coming in at 07:45. Paper-only check-in will not support the same-day CE attendance upload needed for the visiting faculty evaluation review, so the two lobby badge scanners are now part of the attendance plan.

parameter.title: Grand Rounds scanner credential preflight
parameter.content: Attendance shell preflight shows both lobby badge scanners assigned for tomorrow morning, but the temporary education-SSID credential field is blank. Requests entered after 15:30 will not provision for Friday morning live upload.

parameter.subject: Friday morning scanner provisioning batch closed
parameter.body: The 15:30 intake batch for Friday morning education check-ins has closed. No temporary SSID request is queued for Geriatric Falls Prevention Grand Rounds. Badge scanners not provisioned in this batch will cache swipes offline for a later upload cycle only.
